helpIntro: Notre Dame uses a 4.0 scale weighted by semester credit hours. Enter final Notre Dame grades and credits to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For undergraduate institutional GPA. External transfer grades are excluded. University-sponsored study-away and Saint Mary’s co-exchange Notre Dame course grades can count. Repeat Impact is unavailable because both graded attempts count.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.000 quality points; a 3-credit B earns 9.000. Together, 21.000 ÷ 6 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.000 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.667 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.333 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.000 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.667 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.333 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.000 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.667 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.000 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.X: Temporary grade shown by Registrar at 0.000; resolve to final grade when updated.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete shown by Registrar at 0.000; use the final grade after resolution.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.000 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F*: Registrar-assigned failing placeholder when no grade is submitted; 0.000.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory in S/U course; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.W: Discontinued with permission; excluded from GPA hours attempted and earned.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass in pass/fail course; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NR: Not reported; excluded from GPA until resolved.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: External institution grades do not enter Notre Dame GPA.

specialTypes.name: University-sponsored study away
specialTypes.note: Notre Dame course grades earned while maintaining University enrollment are included.

specialTypes.name: Saint Mary’s co-exchange course
specialTypes.note: Co-exchange grades posted as Notre Dame credit are included.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter both graded attempts as separate completed courses. Both grades count in GPA; consult your dean about repeat eligibility and degree credit.
